description: Verification strategy (candle model). EMA cross + ATR stop, long only. In a candle backtest the graph runs once when a candle closes and Index 0 is that closed candle, so the entry is a market order at its close. At most one entry per candle (Last Entry Candle). TP/SL = ATR Stop x ATR and Reward Ratio x that distance from the fill; exit also when Fast EMA < Slow EMA.
